error: chromadb.errors.InternalError: Error constructing hnsw segment reader: Error loading hnsw index
cause: Chroma 1.5.9 (Windows) cannot re-open a persisted HNSW index whose path contains non-ASCII characters (repo is under 'D:/AI thực chiến/'). Reproduced with a 2000-vector toy collection: ASCII path reopens fine, Unicode path fails.
fix: src/config.py: Chroma directory = $DAY06_CHROMA_DIR, else <repo>/storage/chroma if ASCII, else %LOCALAPPDATA%/day06_chroma. The first index (created under the Unicode path) was deleted and everything re-ingested from scratch.
